approvalNotes: HIDMaestro was dropped: its steam-deck-composite profile names only two of the four rear controls and carries no stick-touch fields, and it generates and locally signs driver packages whose INF versions are stamped from the current date, so an exact signed driver could not be reproduced.
VIIPER's steamdeck device carries every control the canonical model defines and needs no WSGM-signed driver: it rides usbip-win2's WHLK-certified/attestation-signed generic USB/IP client driver.
No separate ControllerHost process is needed. libviiper exposes a flat C ABI over blittable types, so WSGM binds it directly.

components.versionPinReason: 0.9.8.1 replaces the 0.9.8.0 pin, which was never safe to ship. 0.9.8.0 closed the pool corruption of usbip-win2#180 that a reference Claw on Windows 11 26200 hit as a 0xA bugcheck in RtlpHpVsChunkSplit during PnP re-enumeration (2026-09-26), but it introduced the attach work-item self-wait of #188: after an attach, the next host controller restart blocks past 300 seconds and Windows writes an EXRESOURCE_TIMEOUT_LIVEDUMP. A driver install restarts USB hubs, so the upgrade itself wedged on the reference machine (2026-09-27). 0.9.8.1 carries #188 as 'Fresh Work Item per Attach Attempt Phase' and keeps the #180 fix. The asset digest and the unchanged Cloudyne EV signer were checked on 2026-09-27. The release is broad, about 100 commits, and its own notes warn of possible regressions, so treat a controller fault after this bump as a suspect. #181, a usbaudio pin-close race, is still open and still does not apply: steamdeck and dualshock4 are HID-class and xbox360 is vendor-class, and none exposes an audio interface. WSGM requests the WSK event (low-latency) receive mode 0.9.8.0 added; VIIPER still negotiates the 0.9.7.7 and 0.9.7.8 attach layouts, so an un-upgraded machine keeps working and never complains.
